components.label: Round impact
components.description: How much your kills added to your team's chance of winning the round, less what your deaths gave away, from how many were alive on each side and who had the uber advantage. Half of every class's rating since v12: a player who takes more fights and wins them comes out ahead even when they die more.

components.label: Impact kills
components.description: Your kills, each worth what the class you killed is worth: a Medic or a Demoman counts for more than a Scout. Adjusted for the map, and on attack/defend for which side the victim was on.

components.label: Impact assists
components.description: Your assists, valued the same way as kills but at a share of a kill's worth: the damage or the spam that made someone else's kill.

components.label: Caps
components.description: Points you capped, per 10 minutes.

components.label: Deaths
components.description: How often you died, per 10 minutes. Fewer is better: every death is a player down for a respawn.

components.label: Damage / min
components.description: Damage per minute. Measured twice and found to add nothing on top of what your kills and assists already count, so only the fallback model uses it.

components.label: Medic picks
components.description: Enemy Medics you killed. A dead Medic loses his team the uber, and usually the next fight.

components.label: Kills not traded
components.description: The share of your kills after which your team did not lose someone within 3 seconds. A kill that is instantly traded back won nothing.

components.label: Untraded deaths
components.description: Deaths your team did not avenge within 3 seconds. A death that was traded at least took someone with it. Fewer is better.

glossary.description: Your assists, valued the same way as kills but at a share of a kill's worth: the damage or the spam that made someone else's kill.

glossary.label: Medic picks
glossary.description: Enemy Medics you killed. A dead Medic loses his team the uber, and usually the next fight.

glossary.label: Sniper duel
glossary.description: Kills on the enemy Sniper minus deaths to him: who won the Sniper duel.

glossary.label: Headshot share
glossary.description: The share of your kills that were headshots.

glossary.label: Backstabs
glossary.description: Backstabs, per 10 minutes.

glossary.label: Healing
glossary.description: Healing done, per minute.

glossary.label: Ubers
glossary.description: Ubers used, per 10 minutes.

glossary.label: Drops
glossary.description: Ubers you died holding, per 10 minutes. Fewer is better.

glossary.label: Caps
glossary.description: Points you capped, per 10 minutes.

glossary.label: Deaths
glossary.description: How often you died, per 10 minutes. Fewer is better: every death is a player down for a respawn.

glossary.label: Damage / min
glossary.description: Damage per minute. Measured twice and found to add nothing on top of what your kills and assists already count, so only the fallback model uses it.

glossary.label: Opening duels
glossary.description: The first kill of a fight, got minus given away. Opening a fight a player up decides most fights.

glossary.label: Kills not traded
glossary.description: The share of your kills after which your team did not lose someone within 3 seconds. A kill that is instantly traded back won nothing.

glossary.label: Untraded deaths
glossary.description: Deaths your team did not avenge within 3 seconds. A death that was traded at least took someone with it. Fewer is better.

glossary.label: Deaths to flankers
glossary.description: Deaths to a flanker: a Scout, a Spy or a Soldier. Fewer is better.

glossary.label: Stationary deaths
glossary.description: Deaths near a spot you had already been killed from twice in the same life: holding an angle that had stopped working. Fewer is better.

glossary.label: Fight KAST
glossary.description: The share of fights you were alive for in which you got a kill or an assist, survived, or had your death traded.

glossary.label: Fight KAST, engaged
glossary.description: Fight KAST, but surviving only counts if you fired a shot: hiding through a fight does not.

glossary.label: Kills in context
glossary.description: Your kills, each scaled by the numbers when it happened: a kill at even numbers is worth more than a clean-up four players up.

glossary.label: Fight swing
glossary.description: How much your kills raised your team's chance of winning the fight, from the numbers and ubers at the moment of each kill.

glossary.label: Caps into a defence
glossary.description: Points you capped, each counted by the enemies alive to stop it. Walking onto a point after a wipe adds nothing.

glossary.label: Caps with your team dead
glossary.description: Points you capped, counted by your own team's dead at the time.

glossary.label: Fight swing, shared
glossary.description: Fight swing, with each kill's worth shared among everyone who damaged the victim in the 5 seconds before: the damage that set up a kill earns part of it, and the last shot keeps at least half.

glossary.label: Spawns delayed by your caps
glossary.description: Seconds your caps cost your own dead teammates by pushing back their respawn a whole wave (8 s or more). Only on KOTH and 5CP: on payload and attack/defend a capture moves the attackers' spawn up. Fewer is better.

glossary.label: Round impact
glossary.description: How much your kills added to your team's chance of winning the round, less what your deaths gave away, from how many were alive on each side and who had the uber advantage. Half of every class's rating since v12: a player who takes more fights and wins them comes out ahead even when they die more.
